## Frequently Asked Questions

What counts as a contact in Nimble?

A contact is any named company or person record in your Nimble database.

How does the free trial work?

Your free trial lasts for 14 days and there is no credit card required. You may try Nimble with up to 5 licenses during your trial period.

How do I purchase Nimble?

After your free trial ends, you will be billed based on the number licenses on your account. Nimble is a recurring monthly subscription and you may cancel anytime. We also offer annual plans over 15% discount for your entire account. Additional upgrades or licenses will be billed on a pro-rated basis.

When am I billed for user licenses?

Nimble's pricing is based on the number of licenses you have on your account. You will be billed at the time you add a license to your Nimble account [Learn more.](https://support.nimble.com/billing-and-account/nimble-billing-policy?_ga=2.115094720.697137249.1690805867-433776368.1686528033&_gl=1*wwz6ee*_ga*NDMzNzc2MzY4LjE2ODY1MjgwMzM.*_ga_4S7MKRDHVP*MTY5MTA1MDg1OS40OC4xLjE2OTEwNTA5MDEuMTguMC4w)

When am I billed for storage and how is it calculated?

Each team member will have 2GB of storage. If you or a team member reaches this limit, you will be prompted to upgrade to add storage in 10GB increments at $10 per month. This bill is applied on a prorated basis for the remainder of the current billing cycle, and you will be billed the full amount at the start of the next billing cycle

What’s a Solution Partner?

Nimble works with Solution Partners to provide a full spectrum of small business solutions. You may have been referred to Nimble via a partner, and their name will appear on the billing page in your account.

Have another question?

Our Nimble Customer Care team is always happy to help you with any additional questions you might have. Send us a note at [care@nimble.com](mailto:care@nimble.com) and we will be in touch!

## How AI Frames Nimble Pricing

Nimble's flat single-plan pricing masks a 20–40% cost gap once teams scale.

Compared to:HubSpot·Zoho CRM·Apollo.io·Pipedrive·Salesforce

- Usage caps on contacts, storage, and enrichment credits trigger recurring add-on fees that compound quickly for growing teams
- Features standard in competing CRMs — email marketing, web forms, bulk messaging — are sold separately, inflating total cost of ownership
- Routinely contrasted against more capable mid-market CRMs and cheaper budget alternatives, landing Nimble in an awkward middle ground for teams beyond ~30 users

[Nimble](https://checkthat.ai/brands/nimble) CRM takes a refreshingly simple approach to pricing: one plan, one price, no confusing tier comparisons. But that simplicity can be deceptive. For bootstrapped founders and small business leaders evaluating CRM options, the real question isn't just "what does Nimble cost?" but "what will I _actually_ pay once I factor in usage limits, add-ons, and growth?"

This guide breaks down Nimble's complete pricing structure, surfaces hidden costs, and helps you determine whether Nimble delivers genuine value for your stage and budget.

## [Copied to clipboardTL;DR: Nimble Pricing At a Glance](https://checkthat.ai/brands/nimble/pricing\#tldr-nimble-pricing-at-a-glance)

Nimble's single-tier model eliminates the typical "which plan do I need?" confusion, but understanding what's included and what costs extra through usage limits and add-ons is essential for accurate budgeting. While there's no tier selection to navigate, realistic costs often exceed the advertised base price by 20-40% once you factor in storage overages, contact limits, and feature add-ons like email marketing.

| Billing Option | Monthly Cost/User | Annual Cost/User | Savings |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Monthly Billing** | $29.90 | $358.80/year | N/A |
| **Annual Billing** | $24.90 | $298.80/year | 17% ($60/user/year) |

**Additional Usage-Based Fees:**

- **Extra contacts:** $10/month per 10,000 contacts (beyond 25,000 base)
- **Extra storage:** $10/month per 10GB block (beyond 2GB/user base)
- **Email Marketing add-on:** $15/month (company-wide license)
- **Web Forms add-on:** $12/month per team
- **Data enrichment credits:** $10 per 100 credits (beyond 25 included/user/month)
- **Bulk messaging upgrades:** $15-$99/month for higher volume

**Core Features Included in All Subscriptions:**

- Contact management with 25,000 records and unlimited custom fields
- Email integration with Microsoft 365/Outlook and [Google Workspace](https://checkthat.ai/brands/google-workspace)
- Social media profile matching ( [LinkedIn](https://checkthat.ai/brands/linkedin-2), Twitter, Facebook)
- Nimble Prospector browser extension for contact enrichment
- Visual pipeline management with Kanban boards
- Workflow automation and email sequences
- 1,000 group messages per user per month
- Mobile apps for iOS and Android
- Daily Q&A sessions and weekly training webinars (no extra onboarding fees)

## [Copied to clipboardWhat You Get At Each Tier](https://checkthat.ai/brands/nimble/pricing\#what-you-get-at-each-tier)

Unlike most CRMs that segment features across multiple pricing levels, Nimble offers a single Business Plan with identical core CRM functionality for all users.

### [Copied to clipboardNimble CRM: Single Business Plan ($24.90/month annual or $29.90/month)](https://checkthat.ai/brands/nimble/pricing\#nimble-crm-single-business-plan-2490month-annual-or-2990month)

**Overview:** The Business Plan is Nimble's only option, providing complete access to all CRM capabilities. The pricing model is straightforward: you pay a fixed monthly or annual rate per user with no feature-based tiers. However, usage limits on contacts (25,000 base), storage (2GB per user), and messaging (1,000 per user/month) may trigger additional charges when exceeded, and add-ons like Email Marketing ($15/month) and Data Enrichment credits ($10 per 100 credits) are available when you need expanded capabilities.

**Best for:** Relationship-driven businesses (consultancies, agencies, professional services) with 5-30 employees who rely on LinkedIn and email for prospecting. Teams that value social selling intelligence and contact enrichment over high-volume transaction processing.

**What's included:**

- **Contact & Relationship Management:** 25,000 contact records, automatic enrichment from multiple data sources (25 enrichment credits/user/month included), social profile aggregation, unlimited tags and custom fields
- **Email Tools:** Native sync with Gmail and Outlook, email tracking (opens/clicks), templates with AI assistance, scheduled follow-ups (advanced email marketing campaigns require $15/month add-on)
- **Sales Pipeline:** Unlimited deals, visual Kanban boards, multiple pipeline support, deal forecasting
- **Social Selling:** Prospector browser extension works on LinkedIn and company websites, automatic profile matching, 25 enrichment credits/user/month included
- **Automation:** Workflow builder with triggers and actions, email sequences, task automation, stay-in-touch reminders
- **Team Features:** Shared contact database, activity visibility, task delegation, team dashboards
- **Support:** Included onboarding with 1:1 consultation calls, daily live Q&A sessions, weekly training webinars

**Verdict:** The Business Plan delivers strong value for relationship-focused small teams. At $24.90/user/month (annual billing), you're getting social integration and contact enrichment features that competitors charge significantly more for. However, plan for realistic costs 20-40% higher than base pricing once you factor in storage overages, contact limits, and email marketing add-ons. [HubSpot](https://checkthat.ai/brands/hubspot) requires its Professional tier ($450+/month minimum for 3 users) for comparable automation, while Zoho CRM Professional ($23/month) actually offers more comprehensive features at 7% lower cost, though with weaker social integration. Nimble excels for consultants and agencies where relationship intelligence drives revenue; growing sales teams may find better value in alternatives.

The single-tier model works well if Nimble's feature set matches your needs. However, if you only need basic contact management, you're paying for capabilities you won't use, and cheaper alternatives like Zoho CRM Standard ($14/month) or [Pipedrive](https://checkthat.ai/brands/pipedrive) Essential ($14/month) exist that offer comparable features at 44% lower cost.

## [Copied to clipboardHidden Costs & Add-ons](https://checkthat.ai/brands/nimble/pricing\#hidden-costs-add-ons)

Nimble's pricing page emphasizes simplicity with its single-tier model, but growing teams often encounter usage limits that require additional charges. Understanding these potential costs upfront prevents budget surprises.

**Usage Limits That Trigger Additional Charges:**

| Usage Element | Included | Overage Cost | When You'll Hit It |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Contact records | 25,000/account | $10/month per 10K | Growing teams at $3-5M revenue |
| Storage | 2GB/user | $10/month per 10GB block | Document-heavy workflows, large email sync |
| Group messages | 1,000/user/month | $15-$99/month tiers | High-volume prospecting |
| Data enrichment | 25 credits/user/month | $10 per 100 credits | LinkedIn-heavy prospecting |

**Add-On Features:**

| Add-On | Cost | What It Unlocks |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Email Marketing | $15/month (company-wide) | Campaign builder, A/B testing, advanced segmentation |
| Web Forms | $12/month per team | Website lead capture forms |

**What's NOT Included (Feature Gaps):**

- **No native calling/SMS:** Phone-based sales teams need third-party integration
- **Limited marketing automation:** Basic sequences only; advanced drip campaigns require Email Marketing add-on
- **Moderate reporting depth:** No AI-powered predictive analytics or custom report builder
- **API limitations:** Rate limits apply to API access, which can impact real-time integrations

**Billing Terms & Contract Details:**

- **No minimum contract:** Choose monthly or annual billing
- **No setup fees:** Onboarding included at no additional cost
- **No refunds:** Cancellations don't trigger pro-rated refunds, even on annual plans
- **Restriction model:** Hitting limits stops functionality (email sync, contact creation) rather than triggering automatic charges

**Real Cost Scenario for a 10-Person Team:**

- **Advertised cost:** $2,988/year (10 users × $298.80 annual)
- **Realistic cost with growth:** $3,408-$5,196/year (adding contact overage, email marketing, storage)
- **Difference:** 14-74% above base pricing

The gap between advertised and actual costs is manageable but significant for bootstrapped budgets. Plan for approximately 8-30% additional spend beyond base subscription as your team and data grow.

## [Copied to clipboardIs Nimble Worth It for Small Businesses?](https://checkthat.ai/brands/nimble/pricing\#is-nimble-worth-it-for-small-businesses)

User sentiment about Nimble's pricing value varies significantly by company profile and stage:

- **Relationship-driven micro agencies (5-10 people):** Consistently praise the value, with users noting exceptional ROI from contact enrichment and social integration
- **Early-stage SaaS companies (10-30 people):** View Nimble as acceptable for their current stage but recognize it as a temporary solution before outgrowing the platform
- **Growing sales-driven teams (20-50 people):** Experience mixed sentiment, with many feeling constrained by automation limitations and weak reporting capabilities relative to the $25/month cost
- **Call-heavy sales operations:** Find Nimble ineffective due to missing native calling and click-to-dial functionality

**What Users Say:**

> "Cost-effective and I find it to be far way more affordable than some competitors." — Delly S., Telemarketer (GetApp)

> "I personally find the pricing to be relatively high compared to other customer relationship management (CRM) tools." — Harsha S., Web Developer (Capterra)

> "I have used up my 5GB plan limits and need to upgrade to a more expensive plan." — User Review (GetApp)

The storage limit complaint appears frequently across review platforms. Users discover the 2GB/user cap only after email syncing stops or document uploads fail, a transparency gap that creates trust issues despite the information technically being available in support documentation.

**Value Assessment by Business Stage:**

- **Micro agencies (5-15 people):** Maximum value. Contact enrichment saves 5-10 hours weekly per user. At $50/hour, that's $13,000 annual value versus $1,500-3,000 platform cost.
- **Early-stage SaaS (10-30 people):** Conditional value. Works well as a 12-24 month tactical solution, but most teams outgrow it as automation and reporting needs increase.
- **Growing sales teams (30-50 people):** Diminishing value. Feature gaps in reporting and automation become painful. Competitors offer more depth at similar prices.

**ROI Considerations:**

The primary ROI driver is time savings from automatic contact enrichment and social profile aggregation. Users report saving 5-10 hours weekly on prospect research, time that can be redirected to actual selling. For relationship-driven businesses where meeting preparation quality directly impacts close rates, this intelligence advantage often justifies the subscription cost.

**When Nimble's Pricing Makes Sense:**

- Your revenue depends on personal networks and LinkedIn relationships
- Average deal sizes are $5K-$50K with 30-90 day sales cycles
- Team size is 5-30 people with no immediate plans to exceed 50
- Social selling is core to your go-to-market strategy
- You value simplicity and fast deployment over customization
- You're likely to outgrow the platform within 12-24 months as you scale

**When to Look Elsewhere:**

- You need advanced reporting, forecasting, or custom analytics
- Call volume exceeds 50+ calls/day per rep (no native calling)
- You're planning to scale beyond 50 employees within 18 months
- Marketing automation beyond basic sequences is essential
- Budget is under $24.90/user/month (Nimble's actual base pricing)

**Bottom Line:** Nimble delivers genuine value for relationship-driven small businesses where social intelligence directly impacts revenue. At $24.90/user/month with annual billing ($29.90/month on monthly plans), it's competitively priced for its niche, though 7-23% more expensive than alternatives like Zoho Professional ($23/month) or [monday.com](https://checkthat.ai/brands/monday-com) Pro ($19/month). However, realistic costs typically run 20-40% higher than base pricing once you account for contact overages, storage upgrades, and add-ons like email marketing. If your business model doesn't align with Nimble's strengths (social selling, contact enrichment, relationship tracking), you're paying a premium for features you won't fully leverage.
